subject: ADR-190: the manual -- a picker's pool is every option it offers and says how complete it is, read-control answers with the address, a box is published split as well as whole, and the page's own prose about its arithmetic is handed over
body: THE LAST FOUR ADR-187 DOOR FINDINGS, ONE COMPLAINT: the door published a figure and withheld what a reader needed to act on it. The pick pool was slice(0, 6), so a picker offering 66 published 6 and an operator concluded pools undersell; it is 80 per list and 600 in all now, and observe carries `pickers` (selector, kind, host, shown, of) so a cap that bites says so rather than looking complete. read-control answers with the ADR-188 address -- the name to call the control by, which is what a reader identifying one needs next -- and takes it. read-report carries `lines`, every box split into the page's own leaf blocks, BESIDE the unchanged `boxes` that every task holds byte for byte. And `rules`: the innermost .hint and .fine on the page, each with its host, quoted rather than interpreted -- the pheno tracker states its scoring rule (an unscored trait DROPPED from the weighted total) in prose the door never published, and an operator recovered it by experiment. verify_report 149 -> 160, mutate_report 95 -> 104. No page and no task was edited.
